_comment: Shared corpus for tests/test_prompt_lint.py (Python) and tests/parity.mjs (the JS port
inside PromptNexus.jsx). Both runners assert the same status and the same set of
(gate, severity) pairs. Details strings are intentionally NOT compared: the two
implementations format them differently by design, and locking that down would make
the suite brittle without catching anything real.
Every case is tied to a gate or to a drift bug that actually shipped. The ones marked
regression: caught a defect in a released artifact — they exist so it can't come back.
